title: mentha spicata var. oblongifolia
intro: Mentha spicata var. oblongifolia, commonly known as round-leaved mint, is a variety of the peppermint plant. This perennial herb is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of round-leaved mint include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of round-leaved mint include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
